prompt:
Subject: infinity, target meaning "無限".

Composition: A person looks into two facing mirrors whose repeated reflections recede smaller and smaller without a visible final endpoint. Keep the endless repetition inside the actual mirrors.

Style: Use references/invidious.png for style only: thick rounded dark-brown outlines, simplified rounded 2D shapes, restrained cartoon shading.

Framing: One compact composition filling 80–90% of the square; keep all subjects complete. No decorative frame, pedestal, or floating ornaments.

Output: 512×512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and gaps. No text, letters, numerals, speech bubbles, labels, branding, or watermark.
Style reference invidious.png only: rounded friendly 2D cartoon, thick dark-brown outlines, flat colors, restrained shading. A person looks between two facing mirrors where repeated reflections recede smaller and smaller without visible end.
en: The facing mirrors create an image of infinity.
ja: 向かい合う鏡に、無限に続く像が映っています。
